shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
repeated small motifs in a row
human heads/faces in profile within the design
justification: Both surfaces present low-relief carving organized into horizontal registers containing profile human heads or figures, which is a generic shared trait. B depicts a clear narrative procession of standing tribute-bearers carrying vessels, led by a naturalistic camel head, with a band of rosettes above, whereas A is a dense vertical column of tightly packed square glyph-like blocks with compressed emblematic faces and no processional scene, animals or floral border.
